records.label: spacr.qt.timing#6
records.source: GUI STALLS -- a timer that should fire every 16 ms, recording every time it is late. This is the only honest measure of "the app froze": it is the event loop reporting on itself.
records.context: GUI STALLS -- a timer that should fire every 16 ms, recording every time it is late. This is the only honest measure of "the app froze": it is the event loop reporting on itself.
records.translation: GUI 卡顿 -- 一个本应每 16 ms 触发一次的定时器，会记录每次延迟。这是衡量 "the app froze" 的唯一可靠方法：由事件循环报告自身的运行情况。
